questions.q: Which of these requirements is written correctly?
options: The drone must fly for a long time
The drone must be reliable and simple
questions.explain: Unambiguous, verifiable, with a method and a source.

options: Did we build what is needed?
Did we build it to the requirements?
Is it neatly assembled and laid out?
questions.explain: Validation is “did we build what is needed?”.

questions.q: When should you update the documentation after a change?
options: Once a year during an audit
questions.explain: Documentation left for “later” is never updated.

questions.q: How do you check the quality of a documentation package?
options: Have someone else prepare the aircraft

questions.q: Where do safety requirements come from?
options: From the FMEA and the rules
questions.explain: Every FMEA mitigation is a requirement with a test.

questions.q: How is the RPN calculated in an FMEA?
options: Cost of repairing the aircraft after a failure, in rubles
questions.explain: RPN = S × O × D, each rating 1–10.
